source: Implementation of user-provided editorial design guidelines; no separate design agent required
concept: A little life. A lifetime of care.
layout: Asymmetric editorial hero, large serif headlines, photographic arch, thin dividers, numbered sections, spacious restrained service layouts, warm rose/cocoa contrast
motion: Framer Motion masked hero lines, one subtle hero parallax, viewport reveals, Lenis momentum scroll, one slow marquee, reduced-motion alternatives
imagery: Actual sourced portrait of Dr Aditya from Ova Care; Unsplash maternity and mother/baby photographs are illustrative, not patient imagery
restrictions: No invented outcomes, ratings, clinic addresses, opening hours, or functional integrations. Keep the project frontend only.
